code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService (createWorkItemForPRSC = placeholder). ocmsadminui pages/Report (Court Rejected Reports stub), pages/Dashboard (empty), utils/data/LinkData (Work Items menu commented out), utils/models/Icourtmention.d.ts (roms_error_code, type only). ocmsadminapi, ocmseserviceapi, ocmseserviceui, thirdpartyapi: no related code
note: Sheet status is blank and the demo remark is empty (requirement status not given); the story is traced normally. The story asks OCMS to create a work item on the OIC dashboard for processing errors after the court reports are generated. Not found: recording of court processing errors (roms_error_code is only a field in the TypeScript type Icourtmention), a real court error report (stub), work item creation (placeholder DataHiveUenFinService:2920-2924), and the work item on the dashboard (empty; menu commented out). Searched with synonyms work item, error, rejected, roms, court across the six repos. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. There is no code to detect court processing errors or to create an OIC work item.

steps.step: OCMS has generated the reports on processing of approved applications and mention cases
steps.detail: The staff portal Report page has four court entries (Court Application Vault, Court Application Submit, Court Summon, Court Rejected) but only as stubs: empty path, the 'courtcasesummary' endpoint is commented out, and ReportList.tsx does not list them. The report this story depends on does not exist yet (see OCMS24.7).

steps.step: OCMS detects and records court processing errors
steps.detail: The only trace of a court error is the roms_error_code field in the TypeScript type Icourtmention (line 22), with no backend entity or endpoint. No code fills or reads court-processing errors. The 'Court Rejected' filter in ActionReport is commented out.

steps.step: OCMS creates a work item for the processing errors (if any)
steps.detail: Code creates no work item for the Court Processing Officer. The only work-item method, DataHiveUenFinService.createWorkItemForPRSC, just logs '[PLACEHOLDER] Work item creation skipped' and its comment says 'feature not ready'. There is no ocms_work_item entity/repository in ocmsadminapi or ocmsadminprivateapi.

steps.step: The OIC sees the error work item on the dashboard and learns of the errors
steps.detail: The staff portal dashboard is empty: Dashboard.tsx renders one row div with no widget, and the 'Work Items' menu (LinkWorkItem) is commented out in LinkData.tsx under '//! UNCONFIRMED'. There is no work-item list page. The only UI creator of work items is the UPL Endorsement flow (useEndorsement.tsx:56,119 calls endpoint 'workitem' with work_ref 'UPL Endorsement'), not court; the 'workitem' endpoint itself does not exist in ocmsadminapi/ocmsadminprivateapi (cannot verify from repo whether another service has it).
